content: MK: in the Sharḥ al-Basmala Ibn Turka addresses his "intended sultan-scientist (al-sulṭān al-faylasūf) patron" -- Ulugh Beg -- with the line MK translates: "Long have I held out hope for just such a time – and that time is yours!" (MS Majlis 10196, f. 332b, Arabic given in MK's n.70).
